description: Text layer of an uploaded two-page utility bill (synthetic), statement dated Wed Oct 14, 2026, Denver. One payment deadline with an amount and a full date, and one request on page 2 with a month-day and no year. Page footers are kept as a PDF text layer leaves them. The fixture format has no page-offset field and evals/run.ts does not pass pageOffsets, so page numbers are not scored.
